title: Drought and Fire Risk in Timor-Leste: What El Niño Means for Our Communities
methodology: UNDP synthesis of cited assessments and hazard mapping.
limitations: Secondary synthesis within an official feature; historic losses are not a measured 2026 national harvest.

title: Timor-Leste Launches ASIS Portal and National Drought Monitoring Tool
limitations: Design commitments and intended benefits are not verified outcomes.

title: Safeguarding rural communities and their physical assets from climate-induced disasters in Timor-Leste
limitations: Undated implementer reporting; intended final coverage and reported achievements differ.

title: Human Security of Border Communities in Covalima, Bobonaro and RAEOA, Timor-Leste: Mapping and Assessment Report
organization: Institute for Peace, Conflict and Social Studies, Universidade Nacional Timor Lorosa’e; commissioned by UNICEF and IOM
temporal_coverage: Participatory assessment fieldwork in 2023; includes historical examples, including a 2021 displacement event.
methodology: Qualitative mapping through 2023 focus groups, interviews and workshops in 23 border villages.
limitations: Sampled participant accounts, not prevalence or climate-attribution analysis.

title: Climate Rationale for Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Services in Timor-Leste
organization: IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute and UNICEF Timor-Leste
temporal_coverage: Climate and WASH policy/risk review published August 2025; projections vary by stated scenario and horizon.
methodology: Climate and WASH policy/literature review with expert task-force validation and a June 2025 workshop.
limitations: Mixed data vintages; the cited water-dispute evidence is from 2017, not a current conflict assessment.

title: UNICEF Timor-Leste Annual Report 2024: Action and Impact for Every Child
methodology: UNICEF annual programme reporting of activities and outputs.
limitations: Implementer-reported outputs; expected water benefits are not measured impacts.

title: Mercy Corps, EU, and KOICA hand over Early Warning System devices to DNMG
temporal_coverage: Early-warning handover and project descriptions reported in March 2024.
methodology: Local news report on project handover and statements by implementing partners.
limitations: Descriptive reporting; the article gives inconsistent counts for supported PREPARADU sucos.

title: European Union and Mercy Corps celebrate successful conclusion of Maloa Urban Resilience Initiative Program
temporal_coverage: Implementer-reported programme outputs at June 2024 close-out.
methodology: EU and Mercy Corps close-out account of programme outputs.
limitations: Implementer-reported capacity and works; no independent impact evaluation.
